title: Punctured Kummer charts of a generic smooth-trait torsor
statement: Let $A$ be a discrete valuation domain [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring] with fraction field $K$ as an $A$-algebra, and let $d:L\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be quasi-compact, quasi-separated and smooth [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $G$ be a finite group with $|G|$ invertible in $A$, and let $W\to L_K$ be a finite etale $G$-torsor [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois], where $L_K=L\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}K$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Put $p:W\to L$ for the composite. For every $x\in L$ there exist a commutative ring $R$, an etale map $\varphi:\operatorname{Spec}R\to L$ and a point $y$ with $\varphi(y)=x$, $m\geq0$, $f\in R$ and positive integers $e_k$ invertible in $R$ for $k\in\operatorname{Fin}m$. The rings $R$ and $R/(f)$ are regular [def-weil-regular-scheme], and multiplication by $f$ on $R$ is injective. Put $B=\prod_kR[T]/(T^{e_k}-f)$, $N=\operatorname{Spec}B$, $q:N\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ the algebra structure map and $V=D(\operatorname{algebraMap}_{R,B}(f))\subset N$. There exists an isomorphism $\gamma:W\times_L\operatorname{Spec}R\simeq V$ such that $\gamma;\iota_V;q=\operatorname{pr}_2$. All rings and schemes lie in one universe and $G$ lies in the next. Zero factors are allowed. This statement asserts neither density of $V$ nor normality of $N$.

proof.text: Choose a uniformizer pi by Mathlib IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible. Use smooth_trait_affine_generic_open to obtain an affine smooth A-algebra R, an etale neighborhood phi and a lifted point y, and the generic-fibre pullback isomorphism beta with D(pi_R).

Apply Algebra.isRegularRing_of_smooth to the DVR A and its smooth algebra R. Flatness of a smooth algebra preserves the regularity of multiplication by the nonzero pi. To prove regularity of R/(pi_R), identify it by quotIdealMapEquivQuotTensor with k tensor_A R, where k=A/m_A. This is smooth over the regular field k, so apply the same smooth-ascent theorem. Rewrite m_A=(pi) and map of its span. These are the complete Lean proof of the private helper smooth_trait_regular_quotient.

Map the invertible group order from A to R. Apply regular_divisor_punctured_root_chart to the generic-fibre projection, W, R, pi_R and beta. It gives an etale refinement psi and the root chart over Spec S. Compose psi with phi, use etale stability under composition, and prove that the lifted point maps to x by Scheme.Hom.comp_apply and the two point equalities. The root-chart isomorphism already has the desired composite base map, so its compatibility is unchanged.
